task_description: Process the repository's open GitHub issues, in a reviewable, PR-per-issue way. The single clearly-actionable, un-addressed, client-side issue this run is #209: make the AI-search HyDE query expansion exam-guide-informed so newer/edge AWS services (litmus test: 'Quick' → Amazon QuickSight / Amazon Q) surface.
